cohort: 206 patients who underwent cesarean section in a tertiary hospital in China from May 2017 to May 2020
finding: Age ≥ 30 years, BMI ≥ 24, cesarean section duration ≥ 1.5 hours, estimated blood loss ≥ 400 ml, and urinary catheter duration ≥ 24 hours were independent risk factors for surgical site infection after cesarean section.
